_comment: `shipped` mirrors familiar-plugin.json in the app bundle's Visualizers.bundle/.
It is duplicated here rather than read across repositories because the site is a
separate deploy that cannot reach familiar-apple. site/scripts/check-claims.py
asserts the two agree whenever both are checked out, so the copy cannot drift
silently -- hand-copying these drifted on the first attempt, which is why it is
generated and checked rather than typed.
`submitted` is where third-party entries go, by pull request (point 4). Every
field is something a reviewer can check: a name, an author, an apiVersion and a
URL that resolves. Not 'works great with electronic music' (point 5).
